name: Kyle G. Cameron
residence: In her 2024 WyoFile questionnaire she wrote that she lived in Laramie and had lived there about a year and a half; the 2024 candidate filing used a Cheyenne post-office box. She wrote that she was born in Wyoming, was raised in Cheyenne, and had lived in the state off and on her entire life.
occupation: She wrote in the 2024 WyoFile questionnaire that she worked at an international company and did not name the employer because of the mix of work and politics
education: Cheyenne Central High School; B.S. in social science, University of Wyoming (Casper College distance program), 1992; M.S. in organizational leadership and change, Colorado State University Global, 2015; Master of Philosophy in management, Walden University (2024 research record and WyoFile questionnaire; degree titles as already recorded from those sources)
background: Kyle G. Cameron was the Democratic nominee for Wyoming’s at-large U.S. House seat in 2024 and lost the general election. In her 2024 WyoFile questionnaire she wrote that she lived in Laramie and had lived there about a year and a half, was born in Wyoming, had lived in the state off and on her entire life, and would be 63 on Nov. 5, 2024. She wrote that she was raised in Cheyenne and attended Goins Elementary, Johnson Junior High, and Central High School.

She wrote that she had earned degrees from the University of Wyoming, Colorado State University, and Walden University; that she had homeschooled her children for 15 years; and that her work had included a 2010 Census-taker role and grant writing. She said she was chair of the Wyoming Democratic Labor Caucus and kept her then-current employer, an international company, private. Earlier sourced material on this Profile records a B.S. in social science from the University of Wyoming (Casper College distance program, 1992), an M.S. in organizational leadership and change from Colorado State University Global (2015), and a Master of Philosophy in management from Walden University.
